description: Poll an inbox. block_ms is accepted and capped at 0 in this MVP, so the call returns current events. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

caller_key.description: pf_ key from keys.create. Pass this on tools/call when Authorization and X-Caller-Key are not set. A header key wins if both are set.

title: Wait inbox
